# “We Can Breathe Easier”: How one couple got the help they needed when shopping for a Medicare plan


For roughly 40 years, Linda and Michael F. never needed to shop around for health insurance.


Their


insurance


came through Michael's work. After he retired, they kept it.


But year after year, the price kept climbing.


“It went up so much we had to do something,” said Linda, of Falling Waters, West Virginia.


For the first time in decades, Linda started shopping.


What she found through eHealth seemed almost impossible to believe:


A


Medicare


plan


that could provide the


coverage


she and Michael needed while more closely aligning with their household budget.


“This has to be too good to be true,” Linda remembers thinking.


It


wasn't


.


**Starting from scratch with Medicare**


Michael had spent his career working for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, while she handled operations for a trucking company. The couple understood group health insurance.


Medicare


plans were


different.


“We didn't know about Medicare Advantage,” Linda said. “Would it cover prescriptions? For the first time, we knew nothing about it. Where do I start?”


Linda went online and found eHealth.


The website gave her a starting point, but Linda still had questions about what she was seeing. She wanted to make sure she understood the plan correctly before walking away from coverage she and Michael had relied on for most of their adult lives.


**“This looks like a great plan”**


She connected with


Shemille


Cribb, a licensed insurance agent with eHealth. For Linda, having a person available to explain the details made


a big difference


.


“She answered all the questions,” Linda said. “She understood what we were going through on this journey to figure out the right Medicare coverage for us.”


Shemille


helped Linda and Michael evaluate their options and


identify


a plan that aligned with what they needed. She walked them through the plan options and coverage, including what


additional


offerings were available to them.


“She found this plan and said it was a great option for us,” Linda recalled. “This is what you would pay, this is what is covered and this is the money you'd get back.”


Linda had already seen some of the information online. Hearing it confirmed by an advisor was what she needed to feel comfortable making the change.


“What I had looked at online, I thought it was too good to be true,” she said. “But my advisor at eHealth confirmed it was true.”


After enrolling, they began


seeing


the difference.


**Important coverage that matched their budget**


The new plan provided important coverage for medical care while aligning with their household budget.


“It is a world of difference,” Linda said. “We can breathe easier.”


Their new plan also provides important


additional


offerings


important to her, including helping improve access to care that contributed to her overall well-being.


Looking back, Linda recalls how skeptical she was when she first saw the numbers. But the promises have


materialized


.


“It has all come true,” Linda said.


-


** This story reflects the customer’s actual experience. Individual experiences may vary. She was compensated for her time.*


*eHealthInsurance Services, Inc. is a licensed health insurance agency that does business as eHealth. In NY, IL and OK. eHealth does business as eHealthInsurance Agency. eHealth is not affiliated with the government.*


*The Medicare plans represented are PDP, HMO, PPO or PFFS plans with a Medicare contract. Enrollment in plans depends on contract renewal. Enrollment in a plan may be limited to certain times of the year unless you qualify for a special enrollment period or you are in your Medicare Initial Election Period.*


*We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 55 organizations which offer 4,405 products. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.*
